name: social-feeds
description: Shows your latest Instagram posts and YouTube videos from a copy refreshed every few hours, as page-builder data sources.

instagram_app_id.title: Instagram app ID
instagram_app_id.description: From the Instagram product of your Meta app (business or creator account).

instagram_app_secret.title: Instagram app secret
instagram_app_secret.description: Stored here and never shown again.

youtube_api_key.title: YouTube API key
youtube_api_key.description: A Google API key with the YouTube Data API enabled. Stored here and never shown again.

youtube_channel_id.title: YouTube channel ID
youtube_channel_id.description: The channel ID, starting with UC.

items.title: Items per feed
items.description: How many items a page loop gets at most.

public_url.title: Public address of this site
public_url.description: For example https://example.com. Instagram redirects back to <address>/p/social-feeds/oauth/callback; add that address to the Instagram app.
